::: entry-header
# Advanced Geomatics Seminar {#advanced-geomatics-seminar .entry-title}
:::

::: entry-content

This seminar provides practical exercises in remote sensing, geospatial analysis, GIS, and Earth observation. The exercises introduce and develop workflows using R, raster and vector data, Sentinel-2 imagery, spectral analysis, machine learning, and LiDAR data.

The seminar is designed to build the practical skills needed to work with geospatial and remote-sensing datasets. Each section focuses on a specific topic and includes practical exercises to help you apply the concepts covered.

::: {style="background-color: #f1f1f1;padding: 18px 30px 1px"}

# Seminar Exercises

The seminar is divided into several sections. Select a topic below to open the corresponding exercise.

1. [Week 1 – Introduction to R](./intro_to_R_week1.qmd)

2. [Week 2 – Raster Layers](./raster_layer_week2.qmd)

3. [Week 3 – Raster and Vector Data](./raster_vector_week3.qmd)

4. [Week 4 – Sentinel-2 Data in R](./sentinel2data_in_R_week4.qmd)

5. [Week 5 – Spectral Profiles, Feature Space and Vegetation Indices](./SpectralProfiles_featureSpace_vegetationIndices_week5.qmd)

6. [Week 6 – Random Forest Classification](./RandomForest_Classification_week6.qmd)

7. [Week 8 – Introduction to LiDAR](./IntroToLidar_Week8.qmd)

8. [Mapping Exercise](./mapping_exercise.qmd)
